name: BRAND TEXT
description: We, sino g-int'l electronic co. Ltd, are a plastic, electronics& electrical products manufacturing and trading company with factories and sales both in hong kong and mainland, China. Have being enjoyed a fine reputation for years; we export a lot of our products to the us, Europe, Japan and other parts of the world. Most of our products are certificated with ul, gs/CE, emc, lvd, t-mark, and bs standards. We are also experienced in OEM projects.Our products mainly includes: Home appliance, beauty& health care, gifts, outdoor& travel kits, games& fitness equipments, and also we can offer the services to the customers who want to process/assemble their parts in China factories as required! Owing to the quality products, best prices and excellent after - sale service, in past years, we have earned good fame in the overseas market and attracted many customers that are willing to contact us in business cooperation!  On basis of equality and mutual benefit, we have established good business relation with the customers of following area or countries: Such as USA, middle east area, european market: France, Belgium, Italy, poland and also asian countries, e. G. Japan, Malaysia, etc.  With the development of China joining WTO, we sincerely hope more and more buyers& business partners joined us and cooperate with us for the benefits of both sides!  Your any further inquiries or orders will receive our best attention and handling!
